text.id: Malem itu gue buka grup pendengar dari HP Sekar. Jari gue gemeteran, tapi bukan karena ragu.
text.en: That night I open the listener group on Sekar's phone. My fingers shake, but not from doubt.

text.id: "Ini Raka, temennya Sekar. Tasya tahu Sekar diancam seminggu sebelum dia hilang, dan diem. Dia ditawarin duit sama orang yang sekarang nyari Sekar."
text.en: "This is Raka, Sekar's friend. Tasya knew Sekar was threatened a week before she disappeared, and said nothing. She was offered money by the people now looking for Sekar."
All of it true. And all of it wrong.

text.id: Dalam satu jam, screenshot-nya ada di mana-mana. Akun @carikaksekar nge-repost. Komentar-komentarnya nggak bisa dibaca sampai habis.
text.en: Within an hour, the screenshot is everywhere. The @findkaksekar account reposts it. The comments can't be read to the end.

text.id: Paginya, akun Tasya hilang. Podcast-nya di-private. Dia nggak pernah ngangkat telepon Dinda lagi.
text.en: In the morning, Tasya's accounts are gone. The podcast is set to private. She never picks up Dinda's calls again.

text.id: Bima berhenti bales chat. Didit nggak perlu ngelakuin apa-apa. Orang-orang yang dia takutin udah saling bubar sendiri.
text.en: Bima stops replying. Didit doesn't have to do anything. The people he was afraid of have scattered on their own.

text.id: Dua minggu kemudian, gue balik ke Bandung. Kadang gue buka grup itu. Sepi. Pesan terakhir di sana masih punya gue.
text.en: Two weeks later, I go back to Bandung. Sometimes I open that group. It's silent. The last message there is still mine.

summary.id: Raka menuduh Tasya di depan semua pendengar. Kelompok kecil yang bisa menemukan Sekar bubar, dan orang yang sebenarnya tidak tersentuh.
summary.en: Raka accused Tasya in front of every listener. The small group that could have found Sekar fell apart, and the real culprit was never touched.
